visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot in a modern kitchen. A pair of hands is visible, pouring cooking oil from a light blue bottle into a black non-stick frying pan. The pan is set on a black induction cooktop, and the background features white subway tiles. (2) Several pieces of raw, marinated chicken are placed into the pan using black chopsticks. Steam rises from the pan as the chicken begins to cook, and the person flips the pieces once they appear golden brown. (3) A plastic bag containing white shimeji mushrooms is opened and poured directly over the cooking chicken. Green bell pepper slices are added next, and the person uses chopsticks to stir and integrate the ingredients. (4) A large bag of pre-washed salad greens, including lettuce and purple cabbage, is added to the pan. The volume of greens is high, but they quickly begin to wilt as they are tossed with the other ingredients. (5) The scene shifts to show a fried egg with a vibrant orange yolk being cooked in the same pan. The egg white is bubbling slightly. Later, the egg is placed on top of a bowl of steamed white rice. (6) A small cooking pot is shown where oil is poured, followed by a bag of shredded carrots and greens. Hot water is added from a kettle, and then miso paste is squeezed in using a small green tool. (7) The final scene shows milk being poured into a light blue mug, alongside a carton of Hokkaido milk, a cup of yogurt, a bowl of cherry tomatoes, and a pack of large red strawberries on a table.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 蘿潔塔的廚房. (2) [Subtitle]: 買醃漬好的雞肉，方便調味. (3) [Subtitle]: 先一面煎出焦香. (4) [Subtitle]: 翻面. (5) [Subtitle]: 放入不用洗的菇類🍄. (6) [Subtitle]: 繼續把菇炒熟. (7) [Subtitle]: 再放入一些青椒🫑. (8) [Subtitle]: 其實像這樣就可以了. (9) [Subtitle]: 但我喜歡多一點蔬菜 放入一包生菜一起炒. (10) [Subtitle]: 日本很多洗好切好的蔬菜 方便烹調. (11) [Subtitle]: 像這樣，不用五分鐘就完成一道菜了. (12) [Subtitle]: 再來煎顆荷包蛋. (13) [Subtitle]: 日本有很多蛋，味道都很濃郁超好吃😋. (14) [Subtitle]: 擦掉多餘的油 煎出脆片蛋🍳. (15) [Subtitle]: 微波一碗飯，放上荷包蛋. (16) [Subtitle]: 再煮鍋味噌湯. (17) [Subtitle]: 放入蘿蔔絲生菜包. (18) [Subtitle]: 這種生菜包已經洗好切好 打開包裝就可以吃了. (19) [Subtitle]: 蔬菜稍微炒一下. (20) [Subtitle]: 加入熱水煮. (21) [Subtitle]: 煮滾後.... (22) [Subtitle]: 放入味噌調味一下. (23) [Subtitle]: 蔬菜滿滿的味噌湯就完成啦❤️. (24) [Subtitle]: 來日本一定要喝牛奶👍. (25) [Subtitle]: 每天都可以買不同產地的牛奶跟優格 草莓跟番茄是必吃！✅.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with light, cheerful acoustic guitar strumming accompanied by a steady, gentle percussion beat. A female narrator begins speaking in a friendly, informative Mandarin tone. A distinct sizzling sound of meat hitting a hot pan is layered clearly over the music. (2) As the narrator discusses adding ingredients, the percussive rustle of a plastic bag being handled is heard. The sizzling sound increases in intensity as more items are added to the pan. The background music remains upbeat and constant. (3) A splashing sound of water being poured into a pot is introduced during the miso soup preparation sequence. A small digital 'ding' or pop sound effect is used to emphasize key instructional points. The music continues its bouncy, major-key melody. (4) The final segment features the sound of liquid pouring into a mug, coinciding with the narrator's enthusiastic recommendation of Japanese milk. The music swells slightly in volume before fading out as the video ends. The audio is cleanly mastered with high vocal clarity.
